propertySets.name: Pset_MobileTelecommunicationsApplianceTypeBasebandUnit
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of  IfcMobileTelecommunicationsAppliance and types of IfcMobileTelecommunicationsApplianceType with the predefined type set to BASEBANDUNIT.

properties.name: NumberOfCarriers
properties.definition: Indicates how many carrier frequencies can be managed by the device.

properties.name: NumberOfInterfaces
properties.definition: Indicates the types of interfaces and their number in the device.

properties.name: NumberOfEmergencyTransceivers
properties.definition: Indicates the number of emergency transceivers in the base band unit.

properties.name: MaximumNumberOfRRUs
properties.definition: Indicates the maximum number of remote radio units (RRU) which can be connected to the baseband unit.
